description.value: Harrison Lake Market is a convenience store located on Esplanade Avenue in Harrison Hot Springs, a small lakeside resort community popular with cyclists exploring the Fraser Valley. Sitting steps from the shores of Harrison Lake, it is a practical resupply point for touring cyclists passing through or staying in the area. The two-storey retail building suggests a well-established commercial presence in this tourist-oriented town.
